usedFor: Jandi is where your team chats, and HubSpot stores the note that “Add Notes to Contact” writes.

bestTemplate.name: “New Messsage Begins” in Jandi, then “Add Notes to Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A Jandi message starting with your trigger word becomes a note on a HubSpot contact.

watchOut: “Add Notes to Contact” needs a contact ID or email, so the Jandi message has to include one.
